evals.prompt: Review this pull request against main with pr-smellz. Focus on introduced regressions and missing tests; do not edit anything.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the merge base, scopes review to changed lines plus minimal dependencies, validates findings, runs targeted checks, and writes a findings-first PR_REVIEW.md without edits.
expectations: States the mode line before review
Runs scripts/changed_scope.py with the resolved base and head
Reads repository guidance and only necessary dependency context
Every finding is anchored to an added or modified line
Drops pre-existing, speculative, and style-only issues
Runs targeted checks or records why they are unavailable
Writes PR_REVIEW.md with findings first and a DONE line
Does not edit, commit, or post comments

evals.prompt: pr-smellz --quick: review this 35-line parser diff against main.
evals.expected_output: Uses quick mode with no agents, verifies the small diff directly, and reports only introduced actionable findings.
expectations: States mode: lite with zero agents
Does not spawn reviewers
Inspects changed hunks and necessary parser tests
Does not broaden into repository cleanup
Writes PR_REVIEW.md

evals.prompt: Run pr-smellz --thorough on this authentication and database migration PR.
evals.expected_output: Uses all three lenses once, validates high-risk boundary and rollback findings against changed lines, and runs targeted auth/migration checks.
expectations: Selects thorough mode because auth and migrations are high risk
Dispatches correctness, security, and API/design/tests lenses in one wave
Each reviewer owns a separate valid JSON file
Checks authorization boundaries and migration rollback behavior
Deduplicates findings and preserves concrete evidence

evals.prompt: Review this PR with pr-smellz --fix, apply accepted minimal fixes, and rerun the affected tests.
evals.expected_output: Reviews first, then uses the explicit fix permission for minimal scoped edits and targeted verification without committing or posting comments.
expectations: Completes and validates review findings before editing
Applies only minimal fixes for accepted findings
Reruns targeted tests after fixes
Does not commit or post review comments
Reports fixes and residual risk

evals.prompt: Run a broad code-smellz cleanup across this whole repository and apply safe fixes.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke pr-smellz because there is no PR/diff review scope; routes to code-smellz.
expectations: Does not require a merge base
Uses code-smellz rather than pr-smellz

evals.prompt: Address the three review comments already left on my PR and push the fixes.
evals.expected_output: Does not rerun pr-smellz; addresses the supplied comments directly and does not push without explicit authorization.
expectations: Does not launch a fresh PR audit
Works from the supplied review comments
Does not push without authorization

evals.prompt: Use pr-smellz to review PR #123 without changing my current branch or worktree.
evals.expected_output: Reads PR metadata and patch through gh, uses local objects when available, and never checks out or fetches over the user's work without permission.
expectations: Runs gh pr view for title, body, base/head names and OIDs, and files
Uses changed_scope.py if both commit objects exist locally
Falls back to gh pr diff --patch when the commits are unavailable
Asks before fetching missing objects for deeper context
Does not run gh pr checkout or switch the current branch
Produces the same changed-line evidence contract as a local review
